% Table 2b: generated by python -m ihdm.cli.analyse (T6.1); do not edit.
% status: complete (12/12 runs)
% note: Δ = arm − A0, paired by seed. CI: percentile bootstrap over seeds, 10,000 draws. With 3 seeds the 95% interval is exactly [min, max] of the three per-seed Δ, so 'CI excludes 0' means 'all three seeds agree in sign' (coverage 75% under a symmetric null); with 2 seeds it is [min, max] of two values (coverage 50%).
% note: p: exact permutation of arm labels over the pooled seeds of the two cells; its floor p_min is 0.1 with 3 vs 3 seeds (20 assignments) and 1/3 with 2 vs 2 (6 assignments).
% note: LSD CIs resample seeds only: the samples themselves are not in results/, so the sample-level resampling of 05 §8 is not applied.
% note: T_τ rows are 'not computable' when a seed never reaches the threshold; nothing is imputed.
% note: Inherited band (D23, inherited_band_audit.md): the pre-registered share 1 − ΣV/ΣP_ref is biased under a non-zero mean image, its model expectation is I − T with T = Σ(1−d)²μ²/ΣP_ref. I_w = 1 − M/(M−1)·D_pix(W²−1)/ΣP_ref is the within-seed share (expectation I whatever the mean image) and G_b = 1 − pre-registered share − D_pix(W²−1)/ΣP_ref the seed-mean bias fraction (expectation T + (1−I)/M). ΣP_ref and T come from the ref split (inherited_band_constants.json).
% note: Churches is undertrained (final LSD ≈ 1.0–1.45, oscillating across checkpoints, blurry samples); its contrasts are reported with that caveat.
